headline: Fumba Town crosses 1,000 units in decade-long expansion
summary: The Fumba Town development on Zanzibar's western coast has delivered 1,190 residential units across Fumba and Paje. The community now houses more than 2,500 residents from over 70 nationalities.
why: Master-planned residential developments are a key segment of real estate investment in East Africa. Their progress reflects demand for housing and tourism-linked property.
